One JSON document per map: basemaps, layer tree, controls, popups, search, print, theming, i18n. Only "version" and one basemap are required — everything else has documented defaults. https://map0.net

Schema: `https://map0.net/schema/v1.json` · config format version 1.
Every key is optional unless marked **required**; the third column shows the default a missing key gets.
Objects reject unknown keys in the schema (that is the editor squiggle) — the runtime validator only warns about them, so a config written for a newer map0 still opens.
The schema checks structure; the runtime validator additionally enforces the https-URL policy, id uniqueness and cross-field rules.
Types read as follows: `T[]` and "array of X" are arrays, `a` or `b` accepts either shape, `"a"` · `"b"` is one of the listed values, `{ "…": T }` is an object with arbitrary keys and `T` values.

## Top level

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | `string` | — | URL of this JSON Schema — enables autocomplete and validation in editors. Not read by map0. |
| `version` | `1` | **required** | config format major version — map0 1.x reads version 1 |
| `extends` | `string` | — | URL of a base config to inherit (org-wide basemaps, theme, …). Local keys win; objects merge recursively, arrays replace as a whole. Chains up to depth 3. A config with "extends" may leave out "basemaps" when the base provides them. |
| `meta` | [`meta`](#meta) | — | title/description of the map — used in the print header and as the accessible label |
| `map` | [`map`](#map) | — | initial view and view constraints |
| `basemaps` | array of [basemap](#basemap) (at least 1) | required unless `extends` is set | exclusive background layers — exactly one is active at a time; at least one is required |
| `layers` | array of [layer](#layer) | — | overlay tree (groups + layers) — top of the list = top of the map; runtime-added layers go above all of them |
| `controls` | [`controls`](#controls) | — | which UI controls exist and where — every control has a sensible default; set one to false to remove it |
| `search` | [`search`](#search) | — | type-ahead geocoding search box — present in the UI once this key exists |
| `print` | [`print`](#print) | — | what the print & export dialog offers — the dialog itself is toggled by "controls.print" |
| `theme` | [`theme`](#theme) | — | design tokens for the UI |
| `i18n` | [`i18n`](#i18n) | — | language of the UI |
| `permalink` | `boolean` or [`permalink` options](#permalink-options) | `false` | shareable map state in the URL hash (view, basemap, layer states, user-added layers) — opt-in; true uses the parameter name "map0". Two viewers on one page need different "param" values. |

## `map`

Used by: [Top level](#top-level) `map`

initial view and view constraints

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `center` | `[number, number]` | — | initial center as [longitude, latitude] (WGS84) |
| `zoom` | `number` (0–24) | — | initial zoom level (0–24) |
| `bounds` | `number[]` (4 items) | — | initial view as [west, south, east, north] (WGS84) — wins over center/zoom when set |
| `minZoom` | `number` (0–24) | — | the user cannot zoom out beyond this level |
| `maxZoom` | `number` (0–24) | — | the user cannot zoom in beyond this level |
| `maxBounds` | `number[]` (4 items) | — | pan constraint as [west, south, east, north] (WGS84) |
| `bearing` | `number` (−360 to 360) | — | initial rotation in degrees |
| `pitch` | `number` (0–85) | — | initial tilt in degrees |
| `projection` | `"mercator"` · `"globe"` | `"mercator"` | initial projection — the globe control lets users toggle at runtime |
| `hash` | `boolean` | `false` | opt-in URL-hash view sync — superseded by the top-level "permalink" key |
| `cooperativeGestures` | `boolean` | `false` | gestures need a modifier: Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom, two fingers to pan — so a map embedded in a scrolling page does not trap one-finger scrolling |

## basemap

Used by: [Top level](#top-level) `basemaps`

an exclusive background layer

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (non-empty) | — | stable id — one namespace with layer ids (permalink and the JS API address both by id); generated from the title when omitted |
| `title` | `string` | — | label in the basemap switcher |
| `type` | `"style"` · `"raster"` · `"empty"` | **required** | "style": MapLibre style JSON (vector basemap) · "raster": XYZ/WMTS-REST tile template · "empty": no background |
| `url` | `string` | required unless `type` is `"empty"` | style: MapLibre style URL · raster: tile template with {z}/{x}/{y} placeholders. https required on https pages. |
| `tileSize` | `number` (1–4096) | `256` | raster tile size in px |
| `minZoom` | `number` (0–24) | — | raster: lowest zoom level the tile source provides — zoomed out further, no tiles are requested and only the background colour shows |
| `maxZoom` | `number` (0–24) | — | raster: highest zoom level the tile source provides — zooming in further scales that level instead of requesting tiles that do not exist |
| `attribution` | `string` | — | attribution line, e.g. "© basemap.at" |
| `thumbnail` | `string` | — | "auto" renders a mini preview, or an image URL |
| `default` | `boolean` | — | start with this basemap (otherwise the first one) |

## layer

Used by: [Top level](#top-level) `layers` · [`group` layer](#group-layer) `children`

a node of the overlay tree: a group or a layer, discriminated by "type"

| `type` | Section | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `"group"` | [`group` layer](#group-layer) | a group node in the layer tree |
| `"wms"` | [`wms` layer](#wms-layer) | OGC WMS layer (tiled GetMap) — "info" enables GetFeatureInfo, "legend": "auto" uses GetLegendGraphic |
| `"wmts"` | [`wmts` layer](#wmts-layer) | OGC WMTS layer, resolved from the service capabilities (image tiles; matrix set, format, bounds and legend are picked automatically) |
| `"wfs"` | [`wfs` layer](#wfs-layer) | OGC WFS layer: features are fetched as GeoJSON via GetFeature (WGS84), paged with count/startIndex on 2.0.0, then rendered exactly like a geojson layer — clustering, popups and hover tooltips work the same |
| `"ogcapi-features"` | [`ogcapi-features` layer](#ogcapi-features-layer) | OGC API Features layer: the collection's items are fetched as GeoJSON (WGS84 by default), paged by following the response's "next" links, then rendered exactly like a geojson layer — clustering, popups and hover tooltips work the same |
| `"raster"` | [`raster` layer](#raster-layer) | raster tile overlay from an XYZ/WMTS-REST template |
| `"cog"` | [`cog` layer](#cog-layer) | Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF, read straight from storage via HTTP range requests. RGB/grayscale by default; "color" renders a single band through a color ramp, "hillshade" renders a single-band DEM as relief shading. Bounds and zoom range come from the file header. |
| `"geojson"` | [`geojson` layer](#geojson-layer) | GeoJSON overlay — by URL or inline; supports clustering, popups and hover tooltips |
| `"geoparquet"` | [`geoparquet` layer](#geoparquet-layer) | GeoParquet overlay — the file is downloaded and decoded in the browser (a fraction of the transfer size of the same data as GeoJSON), then rendered exactly like a geojson layer: clustering, popups and hover tooltips work the same. Coordinates in another CRS are reprojected on load — the CRS comes from the file's own geo metadata, or from `crs`. The decoder loads on demand. |
| `"vector"` | [`vector` layer](#vector-layer) | vector tile overlay styled client-side with MapLibre style-spec layers |

## Common layer keys

Keys every layer type accepts (except `group`, which is a container node). The per-type sections below list only what comes on top.

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (non-empty) | — | stable id used by permalink, share state and the JS API — one namespace with basemap ids; generated from the title when omitted |
| `title` | `string` | — | label in the layer tree |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | initially visible |
| `opacity` | `number` (0–1) | `1` | layer opacity, 0–1 |
| `minZoom` | `number` (0–24) | — | hide the layer below this zoom (the layer tree shows a zoom-range hint) |
| `maxZoom` | `number` (0–24) | — | hide the layer above this zoom |
| `bounds` | `number[]` (4 items) | — | [west, south, east, north] (WGS84) — enables "zoom to layer"; auto-filled from capabilities where possible |
| `attribution` | `string` | — | attribution shown while the layer is visible |
| `metadata` | [`metadata`](#metadata) | — | link to the dataset's metadata record, shown in the layer menu |
| `legend` | `false` or `string` or array of [legend entry](#legend-entry) | `"auto"` | "auto" (default): WMS GetLegendGraphic / swatches derived from the style · false: no legend · string: legend image URL · array: explicit entries |

OGC WMS layer (tiled GetMap) — "info" enables GetFeatureInfo, "legend": "auto" uses GetLegendGraphic

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"wms"` | **required** | layer type |
| `url` | `string` | **required** | WMS endpoint (GetMap base URL) |
| `layers` | `string` | **required** | WMS LAYERS parameter (comma-separated) |
| `styles` | `string` | — | WMS STYLES parameter |
| `format` | `string` | — | image format, e.g. "image/png" |
| `version` | `"1.1.1"` · `"1.3.0"` | — | WMS protocol version |
| `transparent` | `boolean` | — | request transparent tiles |
| `tileSize` | `number` (1–4096) | — | request tile size in px |
| `params` | `{ "…": string }` | — | extra vendor parameters appended to GetMap/GetFeatureInfo |
| `info` | `false` or [`info` (WMS GetFeatureInfo)](#info-wms-getfeatureinfo) | — | presence enables GetFeatureInfo on click — false disables |

## `wfs` layer

OGC WFS layer: features are fetched as GeoJSON via GetFeature (WGS84), paged with count/startIndex on 2.0.0, then rendered exactly like a geojson layer — clustering, popups and hover tooltips work the same

All [Common layer keys](#common-layer-keys) apply. Specific to this type:

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"wfs"` | **required** | layer type |
| `url` | `string` | **required** | WFS endpoint (base URL; existing query params like MapServer map= are kept) |
| `typeNames` | `string` | **required** | feature type to load — the WFS 2.0 GetFeature parameter, e.g. "ogdwien:TRINKBRUNNENOGD" |
| `version` | `"1.1.0"` · `"2.0.0"` | `"2.0.0"` | WFS protocol version — 2.0.0 pages with count/startIndex, 1.1.0 issues one maxFeatures request |
| `outputFormat` | `string` | `"application/json"` | GeoJSON output format name the server expects — GeoServer and deegree take the default, MapServer wants "geojson" |
| `limit` | `number` (1–1000000) | `10000` | stop after this many features |
| `pageSize` | `number` (1–50000) | `5000` | features per GetFeature request (2.0.0 only) |
| `params` | `{ "…": string }` | — | extra vendor parameters appended to every GetFeature (cql_filter, sortBy, …) |
| `style` | `object` or array of [MapLibre style layer](#maplibre-style-layer) | — | simplified style: one flat paint-property object (circle-&#42;, line-&#42;, fill-&#42; — applied per geometry type) · full control: an array of MapLibre style-spec layers |
| `cluster` | `boolean` or [`cluster` options](#cluster-options) | — | cluster point features — true, or an options object. Hovering a cluster bubble shows its feature count, clicking it zooms in until it breaks apart |
| `popup` | `false` or [`popup`](#popup) | — | popup on feature click — false disables |
| `hover` | `false` or [`hover`](#hover) | — | short tooltip on hover, e.g. { "content": "{{name}}" } — false disables |
| `promoteId` | `string` | — | feature property to use as the feature id (hover/selection state) |

## `ogcapi-features` layer

OGC API Features layer: the collection's items are fetched as GeoJSON (WGS84 by default), paged by following the response's "next" links, then rendered exactly like a geojson layer — clustering, popups and hover tooltips work the same

All [Common layer keys](#common-layer-keys) apply. Specific to this type:

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"ogcapi-features"` | **required** | layer type |
| `url` | `string` | **required** | collection URL, e.g. "https://api.example.gv.at/ogc/collections/bezirke" — "/items" is appended if missing |
| `limit` | `number` (1–1000000) | `10000` | stop after this many features |
| `pageSize` | `number` (1–50000) | `1000` | features per request (the "limit" query parameter); paging follows the response's "next" links |
| `params` | `{ "…": string }` | — | extra query parameters appended to the first request (bbox, datetime, filter, properties, …) |
| `style` | `object` or array of [MapLibre style layer](#maplibre-style-layer) | — | simplified style: one flat paint-property object (circle-&#42;, line-&#42;, fill-&#42; — applied per geometry type) · full control: an array of MapLibre style-spec layers |
| `cluster` | `boolean` or [`cluster` options](#cluster-options) | — | cluster point features — true, or an options object. Hovering a cluster bubble shows its feature count, clicking it zooms in until it breaks apart |
| `popup` | `false` or [`popup`](#popup) | — | popup on feature click — false disables |
| `hover` | `false` or [`hover`](#hover) | — | short tooltip on hover, e.g. { "content": "{{name}}" } — false disables |
| `promoteId` | `string` | — | feature property to use as the feature id (hover/selection state) |

## `cog` layer

Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF, read straight from storage via HTTP range requests. RGB/grayscale by default; "color" renders a single band through a color ramp, "hillshade" renders a single-band DEM as relief shading. Bounds and zoom range come from the file header.

All [Common layer keys](#common-layer-keys) apply. Specific to this type:

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"cog"` | **required** | layer type |
| `url` | `string` | **required** | Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF URL — the file must be in EPSG:3857 (no client-side reprojection) and the server must answer HTTP range requests |
| `color` | [`color` (COG)](#color-cog) | — | single-band value → color mapping: a built-in ramp ("scheme"/"min"/"max") or an explicit classification ("classes"). The legend derives its swatches from it. Omit for RGB/grayscale imagery. Mutually exclusive with "hillshade". |
| `hillshade` | `boolean` or [`hillshade` options](#hillshade-options) | — | render a single-band DEM as hillshading — true, or an options object; mutually exclusive with "color". Layer opacity scales the exaggeration. |

## `geojson` layer

GeoJSON overlay — by URL or inline; supports clustering, popups and hover tooltips

All [Common layer keys](#common-layer-keys) apply. Specific to this type:

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"geojson"` | **required** | layer type |
| `data` | `string` or `object` | **required** | URL of a GeoJSON document, or the GeoJSON inline |
| `style` | `object` or array of [MapLibre style layer](#maplibre-style-layer) | — | simplified style: one flat paint-property object (circle-&#42;, line-&#42;, fill-&#42; — applied per geometry type) · full control: an array of MapLibre style-spec layers |
| `cluster` | `boolean` or [`cluster` options](#cluster-options) | — | cluster point features — true, or an options object. Hovering a cluster bubble shows its feature count, clicking it zooms in until it breaks apart |
| `popup` | `false` or [`popup`](#popup) | — | popup on feature click — false disables |
| `hover` | `false` or [`hover`](#hover) | — | short tooltip on hover, e.g. { "content": "{{name}}" } — false disables |
| `promoteId` | `string` | — | feature property to use as the feature id (hover/selection state) |
| `crs` | `string` or [`crs` (layer)](#crs-layer) | — | CRS of the coordinates when they are not WGS84 — the features are reprojected once on load (proj4). A code the built-in registry knows (EPSG:31254–31256, 31287, 3416, 25832, 25833, 3035, WGS84 UTM 326xx/327xx), or { code, def } with a proj4 definition for anything else |

## `geoparquet` layer

GeoParquet overlay — the file is downloaded and decoded in the browser (a fraction of the transfer size of the same data as GeoJSON), then rendered exactly like a geojson layer: clustering, popups and hover tooltips work the same. Coordinates in another CRS are reprojected on load — the CRS comes from the file's own geo metadata, or from `crs`. The decoder loads on demand.

All [Common layer keys](#common-layer-keys) apply. Specific to this type:

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"geoparquet"` | **required** | layer type |
| `url` | `string` | **required** | GeoParquet file URL — the whole file is fetched, so the server needs CORS but no range-request support; a file whose geo metadata names a CRS other than WGS84 is reprojected on load |
| `style` | `object` or array of [MapLibre style layer](#maplibre-style-layer) | — | simplified style: one flat paint-property object (circle-&#42;, line-&#42;, fill-&#42; — applied per geometry type) · full control: an array of MapLibre style-spec layers |
| `cluster` | `boolean` or [`cluster` options](#cluster-options) | — | cluster point features — true, or an options object. Hovering a cluster bubble shows its feature count, clicking it zooms in until it breaks apart |
| `popup` | `false` or [`popup`](#popup) | — | popup on feature click — false disables |
| `hover` | `false` or [`hover`](#hover) | — | short tooltip on hover, e.g. { "content": "{{name}}" } — false disables |
| `promoteId` | `string` | — | feature property to use as the feature id (hover/selection state) |
| `crs` | `string` or [`crs` (layer)](#crs-layer) | — | CRS of the coordinates when they are not WGS84 — the features are reprojected once on load (proj4). A code the built-in registry knows (EPSG:31254–31256, 31287, 3416, 25832, 25833, 3035, WGS84 UTM 326xx/327xx), or { code, def } with a proj4 definition for anything else |

## `color` (COG)

Used by: [`cog` layer](#cog-layer) `color`

single-band value → color mapping: a built-in ramp ("scheme"/"min"/"max") or an explicit classification ("classes"). The legend derives its swatches from it. Omit for RGB/grayscale imagery. Mutually exclusive with "hillshade".

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scheme` | `string` | required unless `classes` is set | ColorBrewer/CARTOColors ramp name — "Brewer&lt;Palette&gt;&lt;classes&gt;" (e.g. "BrewerSpectral7", "BrewerYlGnBu5") or "Carto&lt;Palette&gt;" (e.g. "CartoEarth") |
| `min` | `number` | required unless `classes` is set | data value mapped to the first ramp color |
| `max` | `number` | required unless `classes` is set | data value mapped to the last ramp color — must be greater than "min" |
| `continuous` | `boolean` | `false` | interpolate between the ramp colors instead of discrete classes |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | `false` | reverse the ramp |
| `classes` | array of [color class (COG)](#color-class-cog) (at least 1) | — | explicit classification instead of a ramp: exact values and/or [from, to) ranges, each with its own color. Pixels matching no class (and noData pixels) are transparent. Cannot be combined with "scheme"/"min"/"max". |

When `classes` is set, `scheme`, `min`, `max`, `continuous` and `reverse` cannot be set.

## color class (COG)

Used by: [`color` (COG)](#color-cog) `classes`

one class: an exact "value" (categorical rasters) or a "from"/"to" range. Ranges include "from" and exclude "to" — except the class with the highest "to", which includes it. Exact values win over ranges.

| Key | Type | Required · default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | — | exact data value (compared after the COG's scale/offset are applied) |
| `from` | `number` | — | range start, inclusive |
| `to` | `number` | — | range end, exclusive (inclusive for the class with the highest "to") — must be greater than "from" |
| `color` | `string` (pattern `^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$`) | **required** | hex color, e.g. "#ef8a62" — 3, 6, or 8 digits (8 = with alpha) |
| `label` | `string` | — | legend text; default: the value, or "from – to" |

Exactly one of these must be set: `value` · `from` + `to`.
